tasks.title: core/verify pure core: RegionDiff, VerifyThresholds, VerifyVerdict, BeforeAfterFormat + SEPARATOR widening
tasks.description: Add four one-concern files to presentation-feature-mirror/core/verify/ (bugs.json#PP-TD-6 counter-example: never let a file's name stop partitioning its contents): RegionDiff.kt (internal fun changedRatio(before: IntArray, after: IntArray): Float — Chebyshev RGB distance, CHANNEL_NOISE_FLOOR-gated, alpha ignored, integer-only, one pass); VerifyThresholds.kt (CHANNEL_NOISE_FLOOR=10, REGION_CHANGE_RATIO=0.02f, MIN_REGION_PIXELS=64, each KDoc'd with its ceiling and NFR-17 tuning method); VerifyVerdict.kt (internal fun verdictOf(matched: Boolean, afterFinding: String?, changedRatio: Float, regionPx: Int): VerificationOutcome — the AND-rule in exactly one expression: matched && afterFinding == null && (regionPx < MIN_REGION_PIXELS || changedRatio > REGION_CHANGE_RATIO)); BeforeAfterFormat.kt (the one before→after formatter missing from F-5's toolkit, built on deltaLabel/plainValueLabel/displayDelta/unitOf/SEPARATOR). Widen SEPARATOR from `private const val` to `internal const val` in core/measure/MeasureFormat.kt (one word; DELTA stays private) — the prerequisite BeforeAfterFormat needs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: changedRatio: identical arrays give 0f; a channel delta of exactly CHANNEL_NOISE_FLOOR is NOT counted while floor+1 IS (both sides asserted); alpha-only differences are ignored; empty input gives 0f.

verdictOf covers all combinations: matched+no-finding+ratio-above→Fixed; matched+no-finding+ratio-below→StillOff; matched+finding-present→StillOff regardless of ratio; unmatched→StillOff regardless of everything; region<MIN_REGION_PIXELS with no finding and zero ratio→Fixed (hierarchy decides alone); region<MIN_REGION_PIXELS WITH a finding→StillOff (the short-circuit bypasses only the pixel conjunct). This is the pair the amended AC-24 lives or dies on — verdictOf encodes change-evidence semantics, never the rejected literal 'no material difference → resolved' wording.
BeforeAfterFormat renders 'top Δ6dp → 0dp' and 'height 24dp → 32dp · want 48dp' (U+00B7 via the now-internal SEPARATOR) and degrades to raw px when densityDpi <= 0.
grep over commonTest shows CHANNEL_NOISE_FLOOR/REGION_CHANGE_RATIO/MIN_REGION_PIXELS used only to BUILD inputs, never as an expected value in an assert (C-1, bugs.json#PP-TD-4).

tasks.description: FakeFrameBitmap.readPixels (MirrorFakes.kt:183-191) is currently a no-op (= Unit), so it never fills the caller buffer (bugs.json#PP-TD-10) — every ViewModel-level region read would return an all-zero IntArray and every pixel conjunct would be vacuously false, letting a whole class of verify tests pass or fail for reasons unrelated to the code under test. tasks.title: MirrorViewModel.verifyBatch — the seven-step cancellable run + ExitVerify teardown
tasks.description: Replace the log.i stub at MirrorViewModel.kt:388 with the seven-step run on a cancellable verifyJob: Job?: (1) atomically snapshot sessionDeviceId + currentHeld.value — null held ⇒ NoLiveSession, abort with zero rows; (2) GetSentBatchUseCase(batchId) — null/failure ⇒ NotOnDisk; (3) decode the stored frameBytes and compare IntSize to the live HeldFrame's — disagree ⇒ SizeMismatch, abort before any per-annotation work; (4) DumpHierarchyUseCase(deviceId) for the AFTER hierarchy, phase=Recapturing; (5) projectMeasureNodes both snapshots against the shared IntSize — non-empty-but-zero-candidates on either side ⇒ HierarchyUnusable, abort with zero rows (log.w both frame sizes); an empty-to-begin-with snapshot degrades per-annotation to NO_MATCH; (6) per annotation (history's 0-based order): measure() both sides, regionPixels+changedRatio, verdictOf, beforeAfterLabel, publish VerifyFrames, reduce rows; (7) rows non-empty and all Fixed ⇒ UpdateBatchStatusUseCase(Verified), otherwise write nothing. Retain the AFTER HeldFrame in a private verifyAfterHeld field. Device identity re-checked at every suspension point — a change or null ⇒ Disconnected, no status write. Every step under withContext(Dispatchers.Default). Add two new constructor use-case params; wire into PresentationFeatureMirrorModule.kt's existing explicit `viewModel { MirrorViewModel(...) }` resolution. ALSO implement the ExitVerify intent handler in this task (it shares the same private fields and file as verifyBatch): cancel verifyJob and clear all four verify-related fields — VerifyUiState, verifyFrames, verifyAfterHeld, and pendingFollowUpBatchId — then route back to the live stage with the History tab selected (bugs.json#PP-TD-2 lifecycle-hole guard: no field may survive an exit to pin the user on a stale Verify view or write a status on a later unrelated send).

acceptanceCriteria.text: No held frame ⇒ NoLiveSession, rows EMPTY, GetSentBatchUseCase never called, UpdateBatchStatusUseCase called zero times.
A null batch ⇒ NotOnDisk.
A live-frame/stored-frame size disagreement ⇒ SizeMismatch, rows EMPTY, no per-annotation work ran.

A non-empty hierarchy projecting to zero candidates ⇒ HierarchyUnusable, rows EMPTY, zero status writes; an empty-to-begin-with snapshot instead produces N rows all StillOff (the two cases kept provably distinct).
A run where every row is Fixed calls UpdateBatchStatusUseCase exactly once with Verified; a mixed run and a zero-row run each call it zero times.
Phases advance Loading → Recapturing → Diffing → Ready in order; a second VerifyBatch cancels the first so only one terminal reduction lands.

ExitVerify cancels an in-flight verifyJob and clears all four fields (VerifyUiState, verifyFrames, verifyAfterHeld, pendingFollowUpBatchId) in the same handling, then the stage falls back to live with History selected; a plain send issued afterward writes no stray status.

references.ref: .pipeline/sdd/docs/verify-and-rediff-loop/plan/plan.json#knownRisksFromQA (bugs.json#PP-TD-2, ExitVerify must clear all four fields)
.pipeline/sdd/docs/verify-and-rediff-loop/plan/plan.json#scenarios (SC-8, SC-9 happy/edge path; SC-22/SC-23/SC-24 abort paths)

ExitVerify belongs beside verifyBatch because both own verifyJob/verifyAfterHeld/pendingFollowUpBatchId and the same file — splitting them would risk the two editing MirrorViewModel.kt out of step.

tasks.title: Release gates: desktopTest suites, cross-target build, manual end-to-end demo
tasks.description: Run ./gradlew :presentation-feature-mirror:desktopTest :data-repository-impl:desktopTest :data-database-impl:desktopTest :domain-usecase-impl:desktopTest (must be green). Then the cross-target compile+run gate: ./gradlew :presentation-feature-mirror:build :data-repository-impl:build --max-workers=1 (bugs.json#PP-TD-8's Kotlin/Native linker OOM workaround — do not weaken the gate to work around a heap failure). Then the manual end-to-end demo against a real device: send a batch, change the UI (agent or hand edit), Verify, confirm verdicts, send a follow-up, confirm both status writes. If no device/GUI is available, record an explicit waiver rather than a silent pass (F-8 left nine such steps unexecuted — do not repeat that silently).

acceptanceCriteria.text: All four desktopTest targets are green.

tasks.expectedOutput: Green desktopTest + cross-target build logs, plus a recorded manual-demo result or an explicit waiver note.
tasks.hypothesis: A green desktop suite does not prove cross-target correctness (comma/colon test-name failures and Orbit's process-wide dispatcher defaults have both hidden real failures in this repo before), so both gates are required, not just the faster one.
